runtime: Offline JavaScript, float32 arrays and Web Workers; no external libraries

architecture.actionSelection: BANK preference >=0.5 except exact rule overrides
architecture.initialization: Policy first hidden unit is tanh(2*(normalizedPot-normalized300)); output weight4. Other policy output weights zero, remaining hidden weights seeded random. All weights trainable. Explicit own-action prior, not learned strength or opponent habit model.

exactFeatures.targetRecurrence: h(p) = [6*h(2p) + sum(count[s]*h(p+s))]/36, h(p>=target)=1; bust contribution is zero
exactFeatures.largerTargets: Integer grid lower/upper bounds, approximately 512 cells
exactFeatures.scoreArithmetic: Safe integer Number, then BigInt promotion
ruleOverrides: Two-player strict-lead preservation by public bank matching
Final-round strict-lead shadowing with one active rival

training.algorithm: Multi-step PPO with constant-rate plain Adam
training.adamSteps: Multiple per collection across two epochs, averaging up to 1728 positions per step
training.valueLoss: .5 * BCE terminal win share, separate value network
training.opponents: Mixed tables: one featured rival, followed by a balanced weighted deck. Cautious search weight2, each other regular type weight1; a single delayed follower only once every24 games.
training.storageKey: current-banknet-small-plain-adam-balanced-1; copies earlier plain-Adam or smaller-network saves
training.guards: No KL early stopping, epoch rollback, automatic benchmark rewind, LR scale or gradient-norm clipping. Finite-number validation only.
training.log: Per-update seeds, optimizer step and step count, stage, LR, KL, flips, entropy, bank frequency, guard restores, pool fingerprints, benchmark restores
training.minibatches: Global epoch shuffle with balanced sizes, independent of worker count; no discarded or tiny remainder; each sample used once per epoch
training.gradientAccumulation: Sum worker gradients at identical weights and divide by actual positions once per Adam step; balanced minibatches and multiple steps per collection
training.optimizer: Adam beta1=0.9 beta2=0.999 eps=1e-8, bias correction, no weight decay, no gradient-norm clipping
training.checkpointCompatibility: Same weights, Adam moments, step and constant-rate PPO method as v4.6.7. Previous challenge champion/results archived, copied champion provisional on the new mix.
training.defaultCellCoverage: 24 games per table-size/round-count cell; one follower game per cell per full cycle. Default18 cells x24 =432 games.
training.learningRateSelection: Selected rate is used directly for every Adam step, including the first. No schedule, previous lrScale multiplier, warm-up or automatic reductions.

evaluation.cells: Selected table-size range x 10/15/20 rounds; default 3–8 players
evaluation.reference: Original teacher heuristic; old Bank Net 2 import is compared only on the original suite
evaluation.comparison: Independent histories, graph signatures and latest reports for each suite; automatic tests always use Challenge
evaluation.status: Exploratory; suite performance is not universal game strength

scripts.role: Comparison only; unchanged original fixtures, seeds, probabilities and opponent behavior; never promotes or rolls back weights

challenge.role: Model selection; fixed scenarios and paired candidate/champion fixtures, plus independent fresh confirmation
challenge.promote: Paired delta lower95 > 0 in primary and fresh tests; blocked by confirmed per-scenario upper95 < -0.03
challenge.rollback: None. Failed gains or worse results retain the saved best without modifying latest training weights, optimizer or learning rate.

evaluation.archive: challenge-2 results are archived and never connected to the revised challenge-3 graph. The standalone bankbench-46 benchmark remains unchanged.
evaluation.scenarioMeaning: Each scenario groups mixed tables by one featured rival; other seats always use the same balanced regular pool. These are not isolated win rates against one opponent type.

status: Balanced-opponent plain-Adam branch. Same policy/value geometry and constant-rate PPO as v4.6.7; revised shared training/Challenge mix, unchanged standalone original scripted benchmark.

includedExample.claim: Included weights are unchanged from v4.6.2; their existing scores do not establish a benefit from the new training method.

opponentSuite.focalShadow: Waits for the focal player to bank, then takes exactly one additional roll. Banks after that roll if safe, before the next roll; a bust loses its pot. Never initiates a bank. Appears as the sole follower once every 24 games.
opponentSuite.probabilities: Unchanged exact hitting tables where available, large-target lower bounds otherwise; search exactly enumerates all 36 danger-roll outcomes through 10 weighted branches
opponentSuite.search: Two-roll expectimax; fixed node bound, no wall-clock cutoff, no access to hidden dice or learner parameters; approximate public-state rival responses and end-of-round value
opponentSuite.trainingSeeds: Fresh per collection, separate from fixed and fresh-confirmation benchmark seeds
opponentSuite.curriculum: None; type weights, schedule and behavior are fixed, with fresh training seeds and randomized seats/thresholds.
opponentSuite.delayedFollowerState: The focal player is inactive with banked=current-round bank amount. Every safe danger roll strictly increases the pot, so pot>focal.banked identifies the next banking window without private state or hidden dice. A new round resets active and banked flags.
opponentSuite.featuredSchedule: One follower every24 games; remaining featured rivals follow the same weighted regular deck. Background deck never contains a follower.
opponentSuite.strongestPreference: Cautious search favored based on the lower learner win shares against the prior cautious-search scenario. This is a practical choice, not proof that it is universally strongest.
opponentSuite.sharedDistribution: Training and Challenge call the exact same fixture and roster generator with identical weights and follower limits, using separate seeds. Arbitrary benchmark lengths can have small quota boundary differences.
